article.title: The dangerous advance of the far Right in Latin America: U.S. hegemony, Israeli expansion, and Evangelical Zionism in the face of resistance
article.author: Editor
article.content: Latin America’s far-right turn is consolidating a hemispheric bloc aligned with Washington and Tel Aviv, driven by US interventionism, the Isaac Accords, Christian Zionism and Israeli security technology. The post The dangerous advance of the far Right in Latin America: U.S. hegemony, Israeli expansion, and Evangelical Zionism in the face of resistance appeared first on MR Online .
